method.duplicate_key: source identity (URL or explicit field-source identity) + normalized product + type + form + currency + period + date + price_per_kg
method.source_currency_rule: Rows from specialtycoffee.id that were labeled IDR are excluded from IDR charts because the primary source states all its prices are USD; original source-currency prices are not reconstructed without verified FX metadata
method.outlier_rule: Inclusive ±25% band around the arithmetic mean within each type/form/currency/period group; process and market tier are pooled; when no row passes, retain the row nearest the mean
method.chart_policy: source-currency mismatches, duplicates, and listings outside the group mean ±25% band are excluded from IDR chart medians, except one nearest-mean row is retained when a group would otherwise be empty; raw source rows remain in mevo_prices.json
